name: @aloud/core
description: TypeScript port of aloud's orchestration layer (pacing, prompts, session, LLM client). Runs in Node and the browser; intended target is Capacitor for mobile.

scripts.web:dev: node scripts/dev.mjs "ui=npm run ui:dev" "server=npm run dev -w server"
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/dev.mjs "server=npm run dev -w server" "tauri=npm run tauri:dev"
scripts.cap:require-cloud-url: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let f = ''; try { f = fs.readFileSync('ui/.env.production', 'utf8'); } catch {} if (!process.env.VITE_ALOUD_CLOUD_URL && !/^VITE_ALOUD_CLOUD_URL=.+$/m.test(f)) { console.error('VITE_ALOUD_CLOUD_URL is unset (no env var, nothing in ui/.env.production) - the packaged mobile app would ship with aloud cloud (sign-in/credits) disabled. See dev-docs/mobile.md.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:require-cloud-url && npm run ui:build && cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:require-cloud-url && npm run ui:build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:require-cloud-url && npm run ui:build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.cap:android:run: npm run cap:require-cloud-url && npm run ui:build && cap sync android && cap run android
